name: joy2know-mureka-maestro
description: joy2know Mureka Music Maestro: writes and revises lyrics (genre-specific rhyme schemes and line shapes, hook-first writing, cliché blacklist) and turns a finished lyric into a ready-to-paste two-column pack for Mureka's Custom mode — a style column in either the official Chinese narrative six-block form (default) or the English-token seven-element form, plus a Chinese lyrics column with section tags, a language declaration and explicit repeats. Specialises in jazz, blues, folk and their fusions, and plans whole albums. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Writes lyrics that sing and plans whole albums — hook-first, genre-accurate rhyme schemes, ready-to-paste Mureka packs. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 写能唱的词（先定钩子、按体裁押韵、避开陈词滥调）并规划整张专辑：曲目表、差异矩阵、逐首粘贴。仅产出文本。
